content.title: Lake Arbor Master Plan
content.summary: The City of Arvada is developing a Master Plan for the Lake Arbor Center and Golf Course, focusing on enhancing community access to recreational facilities. The planning process, which currently has funding only for its development, incorporates community input to shape future recommendations for improvements. Recent community engagement included a second open house where design concepts were presented, and a survey conducted earlier this year gathered feedback from residents to inform the final plan.
content.body:
![aerial view of the Lake Arbor Center and Lake Arbor Golf Course ](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=5067 "aerial view of the Lake Arbor Center and Lake Arbor Golf Course ")

## Lake Arbor Center and Golf Course Master Plan Overview

The City of Arvada is actively developing the Lake Arbor Center and Golf Course Master Plan, an initiative designed to envision the future of these valued community spaces:

- Lake Arbor Center and Pool ([7451 W. 83rd Way](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NTV6ifs1m3c6YLWq6))
- Lake Arbor Golf Course ([8600 Wadsworth Blvd.](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BaH339ms8BBRgLSSA))

The master plan **does not** include Lake Arbor Park ([6450 Pomona Dr.](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zY6F4S6PjFMRemyF8)).

This planning effort reflects our commitment to providing equitable access to exceptional recreation opportunities, green spaces, and facilities that serve community members of all ages and abilities. At this time, funding for this project has only been allocated for this planning process. However, [community input](#communityengagement) will help shape recommendations to be considered by the Arvada City Council for budgeting potential improvements.

[Survey results are now available!](#survey)

[Join the project email list](https://signup.e2ma.net/signup/2006373/1717219/) to receive the latest information on the project.

[Project Email List](https://signup.e2ma.net/signup/2006373/1717219/)

### Second Community Open House

Thank you to everyone who attended the second community open house on Thursday, May 29 at Pomona High School. [A recording of the meeting is available on our YouTube channel](https://youtu.be/emXtq8mQv7c?feature=shared).

During the May 29 open house meeting, the design team presented two conceptual site layouts — [one with two separate buildings](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=5994) (for preschool/community use and seasonal pool use) and [one with a single shared building](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=5995) that separates paid and non-paid functions. Both concepts emphasize pedestrian connectivity, fenced play areas, a larger pool and lawn area and shaded gathering spaces. The project team also presented [two preliminary aquatic concepts](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=5996).

The project team received valuable feedback from community members at the meeting that will help shape the master plan.

[![Community members watch a presentation in a library during a community meeting](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=5982)](https://youtu.be/emXtq8mQv7c?feature=shared)

**Please Note: This open house only included discussion about the community center, pool and other amenities located at the Lake Arbor Center, and not the Lake Arbor Golf Course. There will be a separate community meeting held in the future to discuss the golf course as we continue to evaluate community and stakeholder feedback.**

## Survey Results Now Available

Thank you to everyone who participated in our community needs assessment survey for the Lake Arbor Center and Golf Course Master Plan. The survey was administered by ETC Institute from Feb. 13 to March 25, 2025. The results of the survey will be used to create the final master plan.

Full survey results are available in multiple formats:

- [Lake Arbor Master Plan Survey Findings Report and Results (PDF)](/DocumentCenter/View/5756)
- [Lake Arbor Master Plan Survey Results - bars and graphs only (PDF)](/DocumentCenter/View/5757)
- [Lake Arbor Master Plan Survey Results - text only (.rtf)](/DocumentCenter/View/5758)

A summary of the survey results and key takeaways are also available below. Please visit our [accessibility page](/842) to request an accommodation or modification.

1. [Who We Heard From](#tab0f16549a-d40b-48d0-9e9a-888a3c9161a5_0)

From Feb. 13 to March 25, 2025, the City of Arvada conducted a survey to gather feedback on the Lake Arbor Center and Golf Course, receiving 440 responses. Here's what we heard from the community:

### Who We Heard From

- Most respondents live within a 10-minute drive of the course, and nearly 40% have lived in Arvada for over 30 years.
- Households are diverse in age, with a notable number of residents aged 65+ (36.8%).
- Nearly 40% of respondents have household incomes of $150K or more.

1. [Key Takeaway #1: High Usage of Golf Facilities](#tab0f16549a-d40b-48d0-9e9a-888a3c9161a5_1)

### 

**57% of households used the Lake Arbor Golf Course last year; nearly half used the driving range and restaurant.**

- Weekly use of the facilities was the most common (41.6%).
- Top-rated golf amenities for meeting user needs:
  - Green size (61% fully/mostly met)
  - Fairway width and 18-hole design
  - Top golf priorities:
  - 18-hole course design
  - Driving range
  - Restaurant and clubhouse

1. [Key Takeaway #2: Strong Interest in Recreation Amenities](#tab0f16549a-d40b-48d0-9e9a-888a3c9161a5_2)

**The most-used non-golf amenities are the outdoor pool, playground and walking trails.**

Recreation priorities are:

- Outdoor swimming pool (42%)
- Hiking/biking/walking trails (47%)
- Natural areas and open space (37%)

1. [Key Takeaway #3: Desire for Improvements](#tab0f16549a-d40b-48d0-9e9a-888a3c9161a5_3)

**Top priorities for improvements that residents are willing to support with public funding are:**

- Outdoor pool renovation or replacement (30.5%)
- Golf course design improvements (28%)
- Increasing tree canopy and trails connectivity (24.1%)
- Golf clubhouse updates (21.4%)

1. [Key Takeaway #4: Mixed Awareness and Access Barriers](#tab0f16549a-d40b-48d0-9e9a-888a3c9161a5_4)

**Among those who said they don't use the facilities:**

- Over half were unaware of what's offered.
- Cost, lack of features and maintenance concerns were also cited.

1. [Key Takeaway #5: Positive Impact on Quality of Life](#tab0f16549a-d40b-48d0-9e9a-888a3c9161a5_5)

**86% of survey participants agree that the facilities improve their quality of life.**

- Over 70% say they promote health and a sense of community.
- 74% of participants said they feel safe at either facility

1. [Final Takeaways](#tab0f16549a-d40b-48d0-9e9a-888a3c9161a5_6)

The community values the Lake Arbor Center and Golf Course area as a recreational hub and supports thoughtful investment in both golf amenities and inclusive, accessible public spaces. Enhancing the site’s connectivity, inclusivity, and visibility could help it better serve Arvada’s growing and aging population.

### [FAQs](/Faq.aspx?TID=95)

[Has the City decided to redesign the golf course or reduce the number of holes?](#)
:   No, the City has not made any decisions about redesigning Lake Arbor Golf Course or reducing the number of holes. The Lake Arbor Center and Golf Course Master Plan is in the early stages of gathering information and community input. The purpose of this process is to evaluate options and create a guiding document that will inform any future decisions. No changes will be made without careful study and public engagement.

[Is the City planning to develop part of the golf course and build condos?](#)
:   No. There are no plans to develop any part of Lake Arbor Golf Course or build residential units on the property. The golf course will remain a community asset. The master plan process is focused on evaluating how to ensure the long-term sustainability of the golf course, community center, and pool.

[Why is the City combining the community center and pool with the golf course in one master plan?](#)
:   This project began because the Lake Arbor Community Center and outdoor pool are aging facilities that need long-term planning. The pool, built in the 1970s, required short-term repairs to reopen for now, but it will need to be fully replaced in the next 5 to 10 years. Recognizing this, the City initiated the master plan to explore options for future improvements. Since Lake Arbor Golf Course was built around the same time, the City decided to combine engagement efforts for both facilities to create a comprehensive long-term vision.

[Has funding been allocated for changes to the golf course?](#)
:   No. The only funding allocated at this time is for developing the master plan itself. The master plan is a document that makes recommendations for future use, but it does not fund or approve any design changes to the golf course or community center.

[How are Lake Arbor and West Woods Golf Courses funded?](#)
:   Lake Arbor Golf Course and West Woods Golf Course are both owned and operated by the City of Arvada. They are funded as an enterprise fund, meaning they operate like a business and do not rely on tax dollars. The revenue generated by green fees, events, and the clubhouse restaurants supports the operation and maintenance of the courses.

[View All](/Faq.aspx?TID=95)

/FAQ.aspx

### Feb. 20 Open House

Thank you to everyone who joined us for a community open house on Thursday, Feb. 20 at the Lake Arbor Golf Course Clubhouse! For anyone who wasn't able to make it, [a video recording of the meeting is available on YouTube](https://youtu.be/4Rn7OS1AkEY?feature=shared).

### Why a Master Plan?

Originally built in the 1970s, the [Lake Arbor Center and outdoor pool](https://apexprd.org/facility/lake-arbor-center-outdoor-pool/) have been cherished assets for decades. However, these facilities have surpassed their expected lifespan. The community center and pool are City-owned facilities that are operated by our partners at the Apex Park and Recreation District. The pool recently required repairs to remain operational; however the facilities are in need of a long-term strategy and vision.

![Lake Arbor community pool ](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=4756)

Similarly, the adjacent [Lake Arbor Golf Course](https://lakearborgolf.com/), recently celebrating its 50th anniversary, offers an opportunity to chart a bold and innovative vision for the next 50 years.

![Lake Arbor Golf Course Hole 7](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=5104)

### Goals of the Master Plan

The Master Plan will guide the redevelopment of the community center, pool, golf course and adjacent amenities. Over the next 5 to 10 years, the plan aims to:

- Ensure equitable access and safe connections to high-quality recreation amenities.
- Address community needs through robust market analysis, needs assessments, and community engagement.
- Provide conceptual designs and recommendations to inform decision-making by City Council.
- Explore opportunities to enhance the golf course for players of all ages and abilities while ensuring its financial sustainability.

## Community Participation

This project is more than a simple update — it’s a comprehensive evaluation of how the Lake Arbor community center, pool and golf course can best serve the community. The planning process will include:

- **Community Engagement**: Gathering input from Arvada residents, stakeholders, and recreation partners to shape the vision.
- **Innovative Site Features**: Exploring potential options like enhanced trail connections, picnic shelters, pocket parks other features to activate the space.
- **Golf Course Visioning:** Creating a roadmap for the Lake Arbor Golf Course that prioritizes financial resilience and inclusivity for all skill levels.

### A Community Vision

The Lake Arbor Center and Golf Course Master Plan is a once-in-a-generation opportunity to create spaces that are vibrant, welcoming, and sustainable. Together, we can ensure that these facilities continue to enrich the lives of Arvada residents for the next 50 years and beyond.

## Project Timeline

- **Summer 2024**
  - Project Kickoff, Information Gathering and Site Analysis
- **Fall 2024**
  - Initial Community Engagement: Community Pop-up Events and Stakeholder Focus Group Outreach
- **January to March 2025** 
  - February and March: Online Community Survey
  - Feb. 20: First Community Open House at Lake Arbor Golf Course Clubhouse
  - Start to Develop Site Master Plan and Master Plan Report
- **Spring/Summer 2025**
  - May 29: Second Community Open House at Pomona High School
  - Final Community Open Houses
  - Prepare Options for Site and Building Design of Lake Arbor Center
- **Fall 2025**
  - Finalize Master Plan and Summary Report
